'''Chris Arthurs''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 1999 Newcastle tournament]] on 22 August 1999 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|MWYHL]], according to Alex Tennet's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d18">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-24-newcastle-united-kingdom-8-22-99d18/ newcastle-united-kingdom-8-22-99], DeckTech (Alex "Greedo" Tennet, 24 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-24-newcastle-united-kingdom-8-22-99d18/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
